title: Charcoal Ash
text: “You—you!”

It all came back to me, like pieces of a puzzle falling into place. The very culprit who killed Filolial-sama and his companions and severely wounded my Father was standing right before me, about to harm my Father and everyone else. I, Motoyasu, simply cannot… stand idly by. I’ll position my spear in the line of his attack to deflect it and strike one of his pigs.
“Oink—!?”
With a splatter, one of the pigs was hit, and blood spattered everywhere. At the same time, a hole opened up in the airship’s deck.
“Wha… the Vanzincro… was deflected… and my weapon was taken… I’m now…”
Staring blankly, Takt watches the pig twitching and convulsing.
“I don’t know what you’re up to, but what grudge do you have against us—”
My Father is muttering something at Takt. But words like that mean nothing to this despicable Trash.
“Youuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu—”
Takt, completely losing it, brandishes his “Claw” and tries to close in on us. But—.
“Motoyasu! What are you trying to do!?”
“This guy… this one, at least, must not be allowed to live!”
I aim my Brionac, cranked up to maximum power, at Takt. I’ll draw out every ounce of its power and show him what happens when it hits.
“Oooggghh!”
The pig in the maid outfit steps between me and Takt.
“Brionac X!”
A thick, high-powered flash of light fired from the spear pierces the pig in the maid outfit.
“Whoa—”
It turned Takt into a pile of charcoal. My Brionac won’t be stopped just because a single pig tried to shield him. With a whoosh, a hole was blown right through the room.

…I ended up killing it without meaning to, but this won’t trigger a loop, will it? Heh heh heh… It seems the only ones serving as the starting point for the loop are Father, Ren, and Itsuki. In that case, killing these guys shouldn’t be a problem.
“‘‘‘Ooogggghhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!?’’’”
The commotion from these pigs is getting loud. You’d better relax. I’ll slaughter them all equally and send them off to the afterlife where Takt is.
“How dare you do this to Takt!”
“Takt… where did Takt go!?”
And just like that, the dragon and the griffin revealed their true forms from among the pigs and started causing a commotion.
“You’re the Spear Hero who killed not only Takt but even my father! I’ll definitely kill you!”
In the cramped room, the griffin charged right at me.
“Father? I don’t know him… Oh, come to think of it, there was a huge griffin I ran into in the mountains. It dropped some great loot, didn’t it?”
“I’ll kill you!”

You mean that gloomy griffin who suddenly appeared and was muttering incomprehensible things to himself? Looks like this is his kid. Since he was with Takt, he’s just as guilty—let’s make him pay with his life!
“Air Strike Javelin X!”

Brionac’s on cooldown, after all. If I were to fire an Aiming Lancer in this cramped room, I might accidentally hit Yuki-chan and the others. In that case, it’s better for me to take aim directly. Above all, an attack of this magnitude won’t vent the frustration I felt back then.
“Gaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa――”
With a *thud*, I blew the Griffin’s head right off.
“Hahahah! I killed it the exact same way its parent did!”
Since I was so close, some of the blood splattered all over me. How disgusting.
“Ugh! This thing’s in the way! I’ll avenge Takt right here!”

With a series of *cracks*, the dragon grows massive and starts smashing the airship to pieces. To think they were hiding a monster like this… that really gets my blood pumping. Dragons aren’t even worth living just for being dragons, but when they’re Takt’s allies on top of that, I can’t kill them fast enough.
“Everyone, get out of here right now!”
“Y-yes!”
The Siltvelt dignitaries nodded and fled through the hole I’d torn open.
“Oink—”
“Die!”

I fled along with them, but in the process, I took the opportunity to spear and finish off Takt’s pigs. Soon, the airship plummeted while engulfed in flames, turning the surrounding area into a sea of fire. A giant dragon flew toward the castle, and the people of Siltvelt began running around in a panic.
“Motoyasu-kun!”

I aimed my Aiming Lancer at the fleeing pigs several times, but there were so many of Takt’s pigs, and the Aiming Lancer’s low damage meant I couldn’t finish them off. My Father called out to me, so I turned around.
“What on earth is going on! And killing the Whip Hero is a huge problem… no, given the situation, I guess I had no choice…”
“I just remembered! That guy… isn’t just the Whip Hero—he’s the enemy you defeated in the future world, the one who’s involved in the Seven Stars Weapons Gathering!”
“Even so… do you realize what’s happening right now?”

At Father’s words, I looked around. The area had turned into a sea of fire, and the flames were spreading to the forest near the castle. The people of Siltvelt are desperately trying to put out the fire, but with a giant dragon swooping down from the sky, the battlefield is descending into utter chaos.
The castle is barely being defended by Filolial-sama and his companions, but there’s no telling when the damage might escalate. Standing in the sea of fire… I gently pointed my spear downward.
“Because of him… my future Father was crying… And Filolial-sama died too…”
“Yeah… I get how you feel. Besides, I don’t know how it happened, but it seems Takt was the one who killed the Hero of the Claw, who had been missing.”
My Father embraced me amidst the flames. In the distance, Yuki-chan and the others are directing the battle against the dragons.
“For now, let’s defeat the rampaging enemy to minimize the damage as much as possible. There’s not much time left until the wave hits…”
“Yes! I’ll do it!”
At Father’s words, I dash toward the dragon… the Dragon Emperor, raging with fury. My target is the dragon’s head… I unleash my Skills there with all my might.
“Brionac X!”
“Gaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”
Since we were a good distance apart in a straight line, Brionac was dodged by the skin of my teeth. Tsk! Well then, there’s only one thing to do before any damage is done.

I’ll unleash the advanced skill of the Aiming Lancer… a skill named after the famous spear of the gods, renowned for its power and accuracy. The spear glows black, and its flight path appears in my field of vision.
“Gungnir X!”
A single black, curving spear… flies straight toward the giant dragon’s head.
“Gaaaaaaaaaaaaa—Guga!?”

With a thud, Gungnir struck the giant dragon between the eyes; it pierced through its skull with a loud crack and shot right through… and the dragon’s head exploded. With a whoosh, the giant dragon plummeted into the castle’s courtyard.
“We did it! We did it, Motoyasu-kun!”
“Of course we did! Now, all that’s left is to wipe out Takt’s pig herd!”
“Wait! They’ve already escaped… Check how much time is left until the wave hits!”
At Father’s words, I looked at the numbers on the hourglass in my field of vision. It showed that there were only 10 minutes left.
“With 10 minutes, I should be able to take out a few of them.”
“Calm down, Motoyasu! Can you… even tell the women Takt brought with him apart from the others?”
“…You’re right.”
That’s right. I… can’t tell the pigs who were there apart from the rest. If I go now, I won’t be able to tell them apart and will end up slaughtering all the innocent pigs as well.
“For now, let’s prepare as much as we can for the wave. Otherwise, the world will be in big trouble.”
“Understood.”
“It’s a crisis!”
Standing before the dragon’s carcass, the leader of the Shusaku clan descended from the sky, transformed from a Beastman into a Demi-Human, and bowed his head to my Father.
“What’s going on? We need to hurry and prepare for the wave.”
“…Melromarc has led his army and invaded our country!”
